QuestInfo.name: Ghost Stumps
QuestInfo.0: This is your third assignment as an informant and this one involves studying the strange-acting #o1140130# enemies with #p1103004# in #b#m102000000##k. You'd better go talk to #b#p1103004##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1103004# tells you that the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior was definitely caused by a puppet, but the puppet is not necessarily on the #o1140130#s' bodies. It could be somewhere outside... You should search the #bPile of Relics#k in #b#m102020500##k and find the #b#t4032319##k.
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved all of the #t4032319#s. #p1103004# seemed genuinely shocked that the puppets were used for such a purpose and told you she'd have to write a report on this. A report? What report?
